==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use Ancestors' Rage if more than one foe is adjacent to the target.

==Notes==
*If a [[shadow step]] skill with a {{1/4}} activation time is in the target's [[skill queue]] after Ancestors' Rage is used on that target, it will deal damage just after the shadow step. Attempting this with a shadow step with a cast time longer than {{1/4}} second will cause the damage to occur before teleportation.
*Similar to other skills with an [[end effect]], if the target [[Death|dies]] before this skill ends, the end effect will trigger upon death.
*Can be used on allied spirits.
